summary: R221 decouples fixed-function D3DCompile readiness probes from the 64-entry detailed signature log cap. Every newly tracked fixed-function signature is compile-probed through the independent 512-entry signature hash cap; only genuinely untracked signatures beyond that hash cap increment skipped compile coverage. The analyzer now reports compile-coverage completeness explicitly. NativeDrawPath remains dormant.

C0_RECOVER.evidence: Recovered authenticated vr-dx11-native-r71 HEAD 68d59edfb7af151a4d2039a5d98bc7cc24c2179d; read AGENTS.md, VR_BACKEND_100_REVIEW_INDEX.md, QUEUE_CONTROLLER_CONTRACT.md, CONVERSION_LANE_STATE.json, VR_AUTODEV_STATE.json, VR regression/history and Issue #14. R220/00313 is durable and was not repeated.

C1_REVIEW.finding: Set-05 F22 remains a bounded evidence gap: DetailedSignatureLogCap=64 also capped fixed-function D3DCompile probes, so signature 65..512 could be hash-tracked yet lack compile-readiness evidence. fixedFunctionShaderCompileSkippedCap was parsed but compile coverage completeness was not surfaced by the analyzer.

review_lenses.architecture: Separate diagnostic presentation/log-detail bounds from shader compile-readiness evidence without activating native draw.
review_lenses.ownership_lifetime: No COM ownership, Reset, resource generation, shared surface or transport lifetime changes.
review_lenses.stereo_correctness: No eye routing, WVP, HUD, OpenXR submission or presentation behavior changes.
review_lenses.performance: Additional D3DCompile work is bounded to newly observed unique fixed-function signatures while the diagnostic census is active, up to SignatureHashCap=512; repeated signatures are not recompiled.
review_lenses.adversarial: If signature diversity exceeds the hash cap, skipped compile coverage remains explicitly counted and analyzer-visible rather than being silently treated as complete.

C2_IMPLEMENT.evidence: TDD RED reproduced the old coupling: source-graph verifier rejected DetailedSignatureLogCap inside the compile-probe block and analyzer regression lacked compile coverage fields. R221 removes the 64-entry compile gate, counts skips only on signatureHashCapHit, adds ShaderCompileSkippedSignatureCap/ShaderCompileCoverageComplete analyzer evidence, and updates regression/static contracts.
